# Project working agreement

## Start with the task

**Standing delivery authorization (1 October 2026):** Dan requires cloud jobs to review completed implementation, run appropriate required validation, then autonomously commit, push and merge into `main` without waiting for another approval. This supersedes earlier approval-before-merge instructions. Preserve other work, fetch current refs, resolve integration safely, respect branch protection and required checks, and never force-push or bypass protections. Failed/unavailable required checks, denied permissions, or conflicts needing a product decision are blockers to report, not grounds to bypass safeguards. Check that merging does not trigger an unapproved production deployment. PR APIs are preferred when available; ordinary non-forced Git merge/push is permitted where the repository allows it and the checked automation does not deploy. Production deployment, production data changes and financial actions still require their own explicit authorization. Report the feature/policy/integration SHAs, remote verification, tests and deployment status.

**GitHub source of truth and cloud-only development (1 October 2026):** private `DanAakesen/Banking` is the sole authoritative source for this project. This applies to every agent and provider, including GitHub Copilot and Codex. Codex must use the current published private Banking cloud environment connected to `DanAakesen/Banking`; follow the [verified cloud execution route](docs/cloud-development.md). The obsolete legacy environment ID is not the current routing target. GitHub Copilot must use GitHub Copilot cloud agent and its GitHub Actions-powered development environment for this repository. Other providers must use their own cloud-hosted agent environment connected to this repository. Local clients may only coordinate or submit work to the required cloud agent. Local IDE agent mode, local CLI implementation and local app execution are prohibited. If the required cloud environment is unavailable, report the blocker; do not substitute local execution or another environment. Before changes, read the current repository rules and refresh the relevant GitHub branch. Commit and push completed changes to GitHub, normally on a task branch with a reviewable pull request; report the branch, commit, validation and PR link. Do not treat unpushed work or environment snapshots as delivered. If cloud execution or GitHub access is unavailable, report the blocker and remain read-only instead of falling back to local development. Follow `docs/cloud-development.md`; this supersedes older local-development and optional provider-routing rules. Merging validated work into main has standing user authorization and must not wait for another approval; production deployment still requires separate explicit authorization.

**Confirmed architecture (27 September 2026):** one Banking app, local or Azure frontend, using the same deployed production API and its separate Dan/shared Demo data. Normal local development must not use a local database, local business backend/advisor, or direct SQL access. Follow `docs/shared-production-backend-plan.md` and the current `docs/agent-context.md` entry. Deployed and API-verified on 27 September 2026. Use the frontend-only launcher; localhost:5444 is the verified active shared host, while the legacy 5443 process has not been stopped. Do not reuse legacy startup instructions or data fallbacks. Automated backend test fixtures remain separate.

**UI consistency (27 September 2026):** before creating or changing any page, component or style in `src/Banking.Api/wwwroot`, read and follow `.github/instructions/ui-consistency.instructions.md`. This covers the composed scenic photo header, panels, headings, tabs, rows, theme tokens and CSP-safe styling. Compare the result with Accounts in a browser before handoff.

## Project context map

Read only the project context needed for the request; do not load all large documents by default.

- `PRODUCT.md`: product scope and user workflows when the task changes or questions them.
- `docs/agent-context.md`: project boundaries, routes to detailed docs, and validation commands. Follow only the relevant route and section.
- `docs/architecture.md`: stack, APIs, data flow, or deployment questions; read the sections for the affected boundary.
- `DESIGN.md`: the affected screen, component, and design rules for UI work.
- `docs/decisions.md`: search for decisions relevant to the change; do not read the full log by default.
- `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`: use only the rule files that match the changed area.
- `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`: load only when the task matches that skill's workflow.

Search long documents by heading or topic and read the needed section instead of loading the whole file.

Use the current user request and confirmed project decisions to resolve routine choices. Distinguish requirements from preferences and examples. A skill cannot expand the user's authorization. Explain a material conflict rather than silently choosing an older rule.

## Work and communication

- Respond in the language of the user's current message, including when the user switches languages. Author and maintain project content in English. Preserve original quotations, source data, proper names, and identifiers. Lead with the outcome; keep updates and final answers concise and useful on a phone.
- Distinguish verified facts, assumptions, estimates, and missing information. Verify time-sensitive external claims.
- Continue authorized work through implementation and appropriate validation. Ask only when missing information materially changes the result or an action needs authorization. Do independent useful work while awaiting an answer.
- Use available tools and the current environment. Do not require a particular model, CLI, remote session, agent role, or mandatory delegation sequence. Delegate bounded independent work when permitted and useful.
- Respect the existing stack and conventions. Choose the simplest implementation that satisfies the requirements; introduce dependencies and abstractions for demonstrated needs.
- Keep unrelated edits separate and preserve work already present. Use an isolated checkout when it prevents conflicting edits.
- Search OIL or another authorized store only when the task depends on prior personal, work, or customer context that is not in this repository; do not make routine per-prompt lookups. Report missing access when the result depends on it.

## Correctness and delivery

- Validate external input and authorization at boundaries. Keep secrets and sensitive data out of source, ordinary logs, and exported context. Use least privilege and established authentication mechanisms.
- Make failures visible. Previously loaded data is acceptable when clearly marked with freshness and failure status; never substitute invented data for unavailable real data.
- Test changed behavior and meaningful failure cases in proportion to risk. Use existing checks; broaden only for unresolved concerns or affected boundaries. Do not chase coverage, line counts, or review scores without a project requirement.
- Inspect meaningful UI changes in a real browser when available, including relevant mobile and interaction states. Fix observed issues; do not invent an obligatory iteration. Distinguish static review from browser verification.
- Completion means the requested outcome is supported by evidence. Report unrelated baseline failures and unavailable validation accurately. Automated checks and human acceptance may both be needed, including identity or consent steps.
- Respect the user's approval scope for publishing, deployment, external messages, paid resources, secrets, and destructive data changes. Template installation grants no standing approval for them. Prepare a reviewable result before seeking any missing approval.
- Record durable project decisions with their evidence and status. Keep unresolved ideas distinct from accepted choices.

## Handoff

State what changed, what was verified, and any material remaining limitation. Provide the next action only when one is needed. Keep future work out of the critical path unless it blocks the requested outcome.
